messages:
Samira N.: Quick sync 1: merchant pilot pushed back unless we clarify how committed tiers map to burst windows. sales needs a simple chart for customer calls.
Hector V.: High-level: commit tier -> base QPS and burst band % -> ramp window. propose three tiers: Standard(1x base, 10% burst, 5m ramp), Plus(3x, 25% burst, 10m ramp), Enterprise(10x, 50% burst, 30m ramp + guaranteed no-preempt add-on).
Priya S.: Ops note: ramp window is critical. if ramp < 5m we need to prewarm GPUs or customers will see drops. also need a cooldown policy to avoid oscillation.
Jules C.: From product side: we should decouple burst band (percentage) from absolute token caps. e.g., 50% of 10k tokens vs 50% of 100 tokens behaves differently. recommend both a pct and an absolute monthly cap clause.
Sales - Rita: Customers will ask for predictability. can we offer an "elastic cushion" add-on that buys 12h of extra spill credits for a fixed monthly fee? they prefer a predictable cost.
Samira N.: Sounds good. Draft commercial options: - Elastic cushion (consumable credits) - No-preempt SKU (premium) - Opt-out flag (fail rather than fallback) with higher price.
Hector V.: Implementation constraints: elastic cushion is simplest as a billing construct that maps to prepaid burst_tokens. no infra change necessary except tagging consumption. No-preempt requires routing and reserve capacity changes.
Priya S.: Observability asks: emit per-tenant metrics "burst_band_usage_pct", "ramp_in_progress", "preempt_invoked". dashboards must surface per-commit-tier percentiles. also add a heatmap of pool-level fairness.
Jules C.: Launch criteria draft: 1) commit-tier mapping doc + pricing table 2) burst band enforcement + absolute cap limits 3) telemetry + dashboard 4) billing flow for elastic cushion 5) pilot with 2 merchants and documented fallback contract language.
Sales - Rita: Timeline? merchant wants numbers for their C-level in 2 weeks. can we get a slide-ready table + pilot terms?
Samira N.: If eng prioritizes, we can deliver a slide-ready table and contract language in 10 days. pilot provisioning may take 4-6 weeks.
Hector V.: Engineering asks: feature flags for tiered burst bands, a per-tenant allowance map, and a soft-preempt algorithm (hysteresis 180s). PRs: autoscaler change, admission controller update, and billing tag ingestion. estimate 3 sprints for minimal pilot scope.
Priya S.: Also require a canary rollout of the soft-preempt logic on a non-prod pool, and a chaos script to simulate sudden spikes. Ops will validate metrics before pilot.
Jules C.: Product decision point: do we expose burst-band config to customers in the console or keep it contract-only? My vote: console UI for Standard/Plus tiers, Enterprise needs contract.
Sales - Rita: Prefer UI for self-serve tiers. Enterprise details through AE.
Samira N.: Action items: @Hector open autoscaler RFC (due Wed), @Priya create dashboard queries + canary plan (due Thu), @Jules draft pricing table and console UX copy (due Fri), @Rita line up pilot merchants and get OK from legal on contract blurb. I'll collate into a PR for PM review.
capacity-bot: Reminder: capacity roadmap sync Fri 10:00AM.
Hector V.: Quick code snippet I'll include in RFC: ``` if sustained_headroom_violation >= 180s and burst_band_usage_pct > tier_threshold: trigger_soft_preempt(soft_pct=burst_band_pct, drain=60s) ```
Priya S.: Ops wrinkle: include an "incident override" where oncall can pause soft-preempt for a tenant for 1hr while we investigate. also auto-escalate if >2 tenants affected in 30m.
Jules C.: I'll add that to launch checklist. Also adding a rollback criteria: if pilot shows >1% involuntary_preempt_rate for any merchant, suspend pilot and revert.
Sales - Rita: I'll prep the customer slide text: simple bullets showing tiers, burst %, ramp windows, and opt-outs. Need a final by Monday morning.
Samira N.: OK team. If no objections by EOD Friday, I'll lock the tier table and file the PR. Thanks! :rocket:
